row.evidence: Better Stack's pricing page sells "Single Sign-On with Okta" and "Single Sign-On with Azure" at "$5 per user per month" (Generic SAML SSO is "enterprise"), and its docs say "User provisioning using SCIM requires a working Single Sign-On (SSO) setup with Okta."
row.notes: Better Uptime was renamed Better Stack; the row is named after the product sold today and keeps the slug. SCIM works only behind the Okta or Azure (Entra) SSO integrations, each a $5 per user per month add-on (Google sign-in is included but is not customer-IdP SAML; Generic SAML SSO for OneLogin, JumpCloud, Google SAML and others is Enterprise). The pricing page also lists SCIM among security features without a price. Responders cost $29/licence/mo annually ($34 monthly); non-responder team members are $0, so per-user multipliers are left null. SCIM deprovisioning removes the user from the organisation (account kept if they belong to another org); deprovisioning a pushed group deletes the matching team and all its resources. Audit logs ($208/mo annual) are a push to an HTTP log drain, not a query API.

auth.token_source: Single Sign-On settings > Okta or Azure > Provisioning > Enable provisioning (Bearer/Secret token)
auth.notes: Microsoft describes it as a long-lived bearer token; no expiry documented.

operations.notes: Docs do not say which HTTP verbs (PUT/PATCH) the endpoint accepts.

deprovision.data_retained: If the user belongs to another organisation, the account is kept and only detached from this organisation and its teams; reconnecting via SCIM re-adds them.

filtering.notes: From the Entra tutorial attribute tables (userName for users, displayName for groups).

custom.how: roleName attribute (namespace urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User) added in the IdP to set the Better Stack role

roles.how: Okta groups named exactly after Better Stack roles (Admin, Billing admin, Team lead, Responder, Member), or a roleName SCIM attribute in Okta or Entra

limitations.text: Deprovisioning a pushed group deletes the matching Better Stack team and all its resources.
SCIM cannot remove the organisation's last admin (HTTP 400 "At least one user must be an admin.").
Entra users must have objectId mapped to externalId or they cannot sign in.
SCIM is documented only for Okta and Azure/Entra; OneLogin, JumpCloud and Google SAML guides cover SSO only via Generic SAML (Enterprise).

auth.notes: Bearer token: global API token (all teams) or team-scoped Uptime/Incidents API token.

capabilities.notes: delete_user removes a member from a team; admins cannot be invited, removed or role-changed via the API.

endpoints.purpose: List team members and pending invitations (email filter)
Remove a team member by ID
Remove a team member or cancel an invitation by e-mail

audit_log_api.notes: Audit events are pushed to an HTTP log drain (e.g. a Better Stack Telemetry source), not served by a query API.

limitations.text: Inviting, removing or changing the role of admin users is not permitted via the API.

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated Jan. 24 2025) marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Sync Password and Group Push (read from page markup).

google.notes: Custom SAML app in Google Admin per the vendor guide (Generic SAML, Enterprise); no Marketplace listing checked.

onelogin.notes: Vendor guide uses OneLogin SAML Custom Connector (Advanced); no SCIM.

jumpcloud.notes: Vendor guide uses a JumpCloud Custom Application (SAML); no SCIM.

fallbacks.notes: JIT via team Pre-approved domains with Okta SSO.
